title: Design, Synthesis and Biological Evaluation of 6H-Benzimidazo[1',2':1,2]pyrido[3,4-b]indole Derivatives as TDP1 Inhibitors: Potent Synergistic Agents with Topotecan against Cervical Cancer.
authors: Zeng, Huang; Qiu, Bo; Yang, Jiunlong; Xie, Yuman; Huang, Hui; Zhang, Shengyuan; Nie, Hua; Wang, Nan; Huang, Zeyong; Wu, Lingfeng; Liu, Jiayao; Zheng, Xuerou; Zhuang, Yuanbei; Yang, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成TDP1抑制剂并用于宫颈癌治疗，虽涉及分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是药物化学与肿瘤药效，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major global threat to women's health. Topotecan (TPT), a topoisomerase I (TOP1) inhibitor, is widely used for advanced or recurrent disease; however, its efficacy is compromised by tyrosyl-DNA phosphodiesterase 1 (TDP1)-mediated DNA repair. Moreover, effective TDP1 inhibitors remain limited. In this study, we modified the lead compound 3b based on the 6H-benzimidazo[1',2':1,2]pyrido[3,4-b]indole scaffold to synthesize derivatives. Derivative 16b exhibited the most potent TDP1 inhibitory activity (IC(50) = 1.52 +/- 0.34 muM). Molecular docking and dynamics simulations revealed that 16b simultaneously occupied TDP1's catalytic and DNA-binding domains. Furthermore, 16b synergized with TPT to suppress HeLa cell proliferation. This effect was likely mediated by enhanced DNA damage, induced apoptosis, S-phase cell cycle arrest, and potentially ferroptosis. In vivo, the combination treatment significantly inhibited tumor growth in cervical cancer xenograft models. These findings identify 16b as a promising TDP1 inhibitor with potential to enhance TPT-based therapy.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌仍然是全球女性健康的主要威胁。拓扑替康（Topotecan, TPT）作为一种拓扑异构酶I（topoisomerase I, TOP1）抑制剂，广泛用于晚期或复发性疾病的治疗；然而，其疗效受到酪氨酰-DNA磷酸二酯酶1（tyrosyl-DNA phosphodiesterase 1, TDP1）介导的DNA修复的削弱。此外，有效的TDP1抑制剂仍然有限。在本研究中，我们基于6H-苯并咪唑并[1',2':1,2]吡啶并[3,4-b]吲哚骨架对先导化合物3b进行修饰，以合成衍生物。衍生物16b表现出最强的TDP1抑制活性（IC(50) = 1.52 +/- 0.34 muM）。分子对接和动力学模拟揭示，16b同时占据TDP1的催化域和DNA结合域。此外，16b与TPT协同抑制HeLa细胞增殖。这一效应可能由增强的DNA损伤、诱导细胞凋亡、S期细胞周期阻滞以及潜在的铁死亡（ferroptosis）所介导。在体内，联合治疗显著抑制了宫颈癌异种移植模型中的肿瘤生长。这些发现将16b确定为一种有前景的TDP1抑制剂，具有增强基于TPT治疗的潜力。
